summary: vloop metrics now emits metrics/v2: time.checks_ms and time.gate_review_ms, a gate-review entry in cost, models and effort, and a derived work/regression defect found by the gate for each check_failed iteration. v1 records are still read and the real-data output of B1-B8 is unchanged.
verified: vloop task gate T11 exited 0 and printed GATE OK.
notes: checks_ms sums iteration/v2 checks[].duration_ms and is null when no record lists any; the final pass writes no iteration record, so its time is not counted. gate-review sessions are session/v2 files named NNN-gate-review.json (the runs reader regex now allows a hyphen); their cost joins cost.total_usd but their time is not in agent_ms. The text summary (print.go) and docs/guide/metrics.md do not show the new keys yet (T15). Closing a brief now writes a metrics/v2 snapshot; existing snapshots were not touched. In a session, internal/cli tests need the VLOOP_* env unset.
